name: Fenrir
description: Fenrir is a monstrous wolf in Norse mythology, son of Loki and the jötunn Angrboða, bound by the gods with the magical fetter Gleipnir and prophesied to break free at Ragnarök and slay Odin.

aliases.name: Fenrisúlfr
aliases.meaning: Fenrir's wolf / the wolf of Fenrir

regions: Jötunheimr (place of his upbringing in some accounts)
origin: Fenrir is a figure of the cosmological geography of Old Norse mythology rather than a being of the historical world. He is bound on the island of Lyngvi in the lake Ámsvartnir, and reaches Vígríðr at Ragnarök.
